form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Kennedy (for himself and Mr. Rubio) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs

form.official-title: To amend the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 to modify the amount by which the chargeable risk premium rate for flood insurance under that Act may be increased in any year.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Flood Insurance Affordability Act.
Section 1308(e)(1) of the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 (42 U.S.C. 4015(e)(1)) is amended, in the matter preceding subparagraph (A), by striking 18 percent and inserting 9 percent.
